criteria_note: Scored A-F, G, X1 (taxonomy; written for paper posts, applied to category/tags) and guide-specific T1-T3, 0-10 per eval/ARTIFACT_RUBRIC.md anchors. A.reason: Coherent problem->units->internals->first deploy->composition->config->ops->KubeRay->choice arc; renders cleanly (even fences, $$ only with use_math). Y keeps its running example coherent through the config and KubeRay steps (it defines reconfigure before using user_config), cross-references resolve, and it closes with explicit failure modes; its errors are a relabelled kubectl output and a proxy-default contradiction. The margin is modest.
